items.title: 2026 ACC HFpEF pathway: SGLT2i, nonsteroidal MRAs, incretins
items.summary: The 2026 ACC Expert Consensus Decision Pathway reframes HFpEF as a multisystem metabolic syndrome and updates optimal therapy with SGLT2 inhibitors, nonsteroidal MRAs, and incretin-based drugs, plus practical tips for diagnosis and comorbidity care.

items.title: Fifth Universal Definition of MI: new pathophysiology categories
items.summary: ACC/ESC/AHA/WHF replace numbered MI types with Primary, Secondary, and Procedure-related MI, add sex-specific troponin thresholds, update MINOCA wording, and support hs-cTn accelerated pathways.

items.title: AMUNDSEN: pre-PCI evolocumab hits LDL goals, not 1-year events
items.summary: In 2,161 acute MI patients, evolocumab before PCI drove median LDL-C to 16 vs 56 mg/dL at 6 weeks and doubled target attainment at 1 year, but death or unplanned CV hospitalization was similar (14.6% vs 15.4%).

items.title: SINGLE-AF: DOACs help intermediate-risk atrial fibrillation
items.summary: First RCT of anticoagulation vs none in AFib with CHA2DS2-VASc 1 (men) or 2 (women): among 1,803 patients, DOAC cut the composite of stroke, embolism, major bleed, or CV death (HR 0.31), mainly via fewer ischemic strokes.

items.title: ESC 2026: new CR, CKD-CVD, and heart failure guidelines
items.summary: ESC released its first cardiac rehabilitation guideline (broader indicated groups), a dedicated CVD-CKD guideline stressing kidney testing in heart patients, and an HF update with staging, simplified HFrEF/HFpEF phenotypes, and 'decompensated' replacing 'acute' HF.
